_comment: Copy this to supabase.json (gitignored) and fill in your project's values. Supabase Dashboard -> Project Settings -> API keys. Newer projects show a 'Publishable key' (sb_publishable_...); older ones show 'anon public' (eyJ...). Either works - put whichever you have in SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY. NEVER put the service_role / secret key here: it bypasses all row-level security.
